sharedMapEvidence: NOT A DIALECT. This is a cable. It carries no register map of its own — whatever appears on the tty is the attached device's, and the dialect that matters is that device's (`epever-tracer-a` or `epever-inverter-v1`, both already recorded with vendor-doc provenance in docs/catalog/README.md). Recorded here so the question is not asked twice, following the precedent set by the 'Not a dialect — cable
gotchas: No vendor document states a baud rate, a default slave ID, a framing, or a pinout for this cable. Nothing to record. The cable is transparent; the numbers belong to the controller.

That is a *connector and voltage* compatibility list. It is

CC-USB-RS485-150U-3.81 and CC-USB-RS485-150U-4LLT are the same USB-RS485 cable with a different device-side connector (3.81 mm 4-pin, and a waterproof connector for Tracer-BP/BPL). They are not RJ45 parts and do not fit the XTRA4210N or the IPower.

One cable is one master on one port. The two-EPEver-devices-one-bus plan in docs/INVENTORY.md still requires readdressing one of them, and an MT50 remote meter on the same bus is still a second master that will collide.
